summary.decision_detail: Reject the sampled observer as production instrumentation. Keep defaults unchanged; use the result to move attribution from short-window overhead screening to a stable resource/control measurement boundary.
summary.interpretation: The longer 32-token window preserves exact observer-off/on output and terminal behavior, but mixed-load Aster and MLX-LM order strata remain far above the 1% stability gate. The timing is valid diagnostic evidence, not a production optimization claim.
